title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34830v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. translated_title: 并非所有世界模型都会怀疑：训练目标与架构如何塑造JEPA与RSSM世界模型中的认知不确定性
translated_abstract: 世界模型通过预测环境对动作的响应，使得候选动作可以在执行之前得到评估。以这种方式执行的动作（即决策）的可靠性取决于模型的预测能力，而预测又仅在模型经验覆盖的范围内才是可靠的。认知不确定性正是标记经验边界所在的信号。在这项工作中，我们对训练目标和架构如何塑造世界模型的认知不确定性进行了广泛的实证研究。更具体地说，我们在两种不同范式的主流模型之间，对事后认知不确定性估计方法（最后一层拉普拉斯近似与集成方法）进行了受控比较：1）LeWorldModel（LeWM）：一种联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），它无需解码器即可预测下一个嵌入表示；2）DreamerV3：一种循环状态空间模型（RSSM），它从循环潜在状态中重构观测。实验在十个模拟环境中进行……
tldr: 本文通过在十个模拟环境中对JEPA架构的LeWorldModel与RSSM架构的DreamerV3进行受控对比，实证揭示了训练目标与架构从根本上决定了世界模型能否有效表达认知不确定性（即“怀疑”的能力）。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows through a controlled comparison between the JEPA-based LeWorldModel and the RSSM-based DreamerV3 that training objectives and architectures fundamentally determine whether world models can express epistemic uncertainty—i.e., "not all world models can doubt."
